title: galium capense subsp. namaquense
intro: Galium capense subsp. namaquense, commonly known as Namaqua bedstraw, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in South Africa, for its various health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Galium capense subsp. namaquense include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
